package.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
package.description: Choose which browser opens every link.

en-US.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
en-US.description: Choose which browser opens every link.
en-US.longDescription:
LinkUnbound puts itself between a link and your browsers, so every link opens where you
want it. It becomes the default handler for http and https, and when a link arrives it
asks which browser — or answers on its own, from a rule you taught it. Rules remember
the choices you make, by site, by profile or by the program the link came from. Work in
one browser and personal in another, without moving a default back and forth. Everything
stays on your machine: no account, no telemetry, no server.
en-US.name: LinkUnbound
en-US.releaseNotes:
LinkUnbound 2.9.0 - Close the picker with a click, or open it centered
Until now the picker closed only with Esc or a click outside it, and it always
opened next to the pointer.
- The picker has an × next to copying the address, so it closes with a click.
- You can choose to open the picker in the center of the screen you are
  looking at. If you change nothing, it still opens next to the pointer.
- The look of the picker and where it opens now sit together in their own
  section of Settings.
What's Changed
- fix(winget): the manifest speaks schema 1.28.0, the one winget-pkgs still takes, and points at 2.8.0 by @rgdevment in #74
- fix(deps): pulldown-cmark 0.13.6 leaves the version RUSTSEC-2026-0414… by @rgdevment in #75
- fix(deps): tauri-plugin-updater 2.14.1 brings zip 9.1.3, closing the zip cloaking, symlink and AES HMAC advisories by @rgdevment in #76
- chore(deps): Dependabot's Rust, npm and Actions updates land together. by @rgdevment in #82
- chore: bump taiki-e/install-action from 2.87.31 to 2.87.32 in the actions group by @dependabot[bot] in #83
- ci: branches named kind/what, one-line commits, and CI that skips what a branch never touched, as Tisty does by @rgdevment in #84
- ci(release): only a sign-updater job holds the updater key, and every signature must name the tag's version by @rgdevment in #85
- docs: winget install by @rgdevment in #87
- fix(deps): cargo-deny lets pin-utils through, unmaintained and reached only through Slint with no upgrade by @rgdevment in #88
- feat(picker): a close button beside copy, and a setting to open it centered on the pointer's screen by @rgdevment in #89
- ci: a pull request pays only for what it touched, and the Mac weighs only the mutants Linux cannot by @rgdevment in #90
- fix: brew trusts the tap before installing, and the welcome link opens rgdevment.dev by @rgdevment in #91
- feat(news): what 2.9.0 brings, a close button and a picker that can open centered by @rgdevment in #92
Full Changelog: v2.8.0...v2.9.0

es.author: Mario Hidalgo G.
es.description: Elige con qué navegador se abre cada enlace.
es.longDescription:
LinkUnbound se pone entre un enlace y tus navegadores para que cada enlace abra donde tú
quieres. Se registra como la aplicación que atiende http y https, y cuando llega un
enlace pregunta con cuál abrirlo, o responde solo a partir de una regla que le enseñaste.
Las reglas recuerdan tus decisiones por sitio, por perfil o por el programa del que vino
el enlace. Trabaja en un navegador y lo personal en otro, sin cambiar el predeterminado
cada vez. Todo se queda en tu equipo: sin cuenta, sin telemetría, sin servidor.
es.name: LinkUnbound
